items.item: User can speak a request and reach the same gates as typing
User is never recorded unless they armed the session
User can hear a spoken result for a voice turn
Stage gate: speech required no new approval gates

bugs.title: Mic track stays live after Voice is on is unticked while recording
bugs.repro: Wait until mic armed (rec=true), untick Voice is on, check live MediaStream tracks
bugs.evidence: live=1 for 10+ s while note says Nothing is recorded; live=3 after re-tick; 16-off-while-rec.png; work/s8-b/t6.log

bugs.title: With Read answers aloud off, listening stops about 55-60 s after each turn
bugs.repro: Untick Read answers aloud, speak a request, watch the mic
bugs.evidence: reply at 27 s, mic re-armed at 82 s; work/s8-b/t3.log

bugs.title: Duplicate spoken request processed after voice off then on
bugs.repro: Untick voice while recording, tick again, wait
bugs.evidence: two identical tidy proposal turns; t6.log

bugs.title: Ask clicked right after typing during a running turn shows Type a message first and drops the text
bugs.repro: fill box, click Ask while a turn runs
